title_sq: Tek Ish Frigoriferi ,Shitet Godine Biznesi Trekateshe!!!
description_sq: Ne rrugen “Siri Kodra” tek zona e ish frigoriferit shitet godine trekateshe biznesi. Godina ka siperfaqe truall 270m² dhe po aq gjurme ndertimi. Cdo kat ka siperfaqe 270m² dhe gjithe siperfaqja e shfrytezueshme eshte 810m². Lartesia e cdo kati eshte 3.2m². Zona eshte kryesisht ne funksion te bizneseve te ndryshme. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At the former refrigerator, three-story business building for sale!!!
description_en: A three-story business building is for sale in the "Siri Kodra" street near the former refrigerator. The building has a land area of ​​270m² and the same amount of construction traces. Each floor has an area of ​​270m² and the total usable area is 810m². The height of each floor is 3.2m². The area is mainly used by different businesses. Has regular mortgage documentation.
